name: JW Marriott Monterrey Valle
positioning: JW Marriott Hotel Monterrey Valle, a city hotel in the heart of San Pedro Garza Garcia with a full spa and an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar
best_for: Travelers who want a San Pedro Garza Garcia base in the Monterrey area
Guests who want a spa and pool alongside a club-level stay with lounge access

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of San Pedro Garza Garcia, in the Monterrey metropolitan area.
The hotel is at Avenida del Roble 670 in Valle del Campestre, San Pedro Garza Garcia.
The gym, spa and pool area are all on the first guestroom floor.
The fitness center is open to all guests 24 hours a day.
Executive Lounge-level rooms include access to special amenities, including free breakfast.
The concierge lounge is a private area with controlled access.
Room types include Junior Suites and a Presidential Suite with concierge lounge access.
Orfebre Restaurant serves international cuisine that blends local ingredients with Mediterranean flavours.
The Lobby Bar offers handcrafted cocktails.
The hotel has electric vehicle charging stations, subject to availability.

highlights.text: SPA by JW has a beauty salon, sauna, steam room, five private treatment rooms and a relaxation area.
The hotel has an outdoor pool with a swim-up bar.
The guest rooms are inspired by the shoreline.

considerations.text: The closest airport, General Mariano Escobedo International Airport, is approximately 35.5 km from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes a business-oriented atmosphere that may feel formal for leisure travelers.
